text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER ALERT: Elevated 5xx and timeouts observed from inference-gateway for model 'odin-v2' (region eu-central). Alert trigger: repeated process crashes on model-runner pods. Paging: @jess_oncall. Details: https://rwd-monitoring/alerts/3345678901

jess_oncall: i'm on it, acknowledging. hopping into dashboards and logs now.

rui_infra: seeing a cluster of OOM kills and SIGSEGVs on nodes eu-gpu-12 and eu-gpu-14. kube events show repeated container restarts.

 tom_runtime: logs from runner show repeated messages: "malloc(): corrupted top chunk" and then segfaults in libkvcache.so. also observe big batch requests with seq_len spikes.

jess_oncall: severity P1. quick mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic away from affected nodes 2) enable variant fallback to 'odin-v2-quant-cpu' for hosted API 3) throttle max_batch_size and reject huge seq_len requests 4) kick off hotfix canary.

ops_lead: agree. cordon problematic nodes and trigger node drains. scale up spare GPU nodes in the pool to absorb traffic.

rui_infra: cordon commands being applied:
```
kubectl cordon eu-gpu-12
kubectl drain eu-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
kubectl cordon eu-gpu-14
kubectl drain eu-gpu-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```

 tom_runtime: pushing immediate routing change in control plane: route 80% traffic from odin-v2 -> odin-v2-quant-cpu, 20% to original for telemetry. applying now.

deploy-bot: rollout: traffic-split update applied for model odin-v2. new split id: ts-3345678901.

status_bot: automated customer impact summary: approx 2.4k failed requests in last 25m. top endpoints impacted: /v1/chat, /v1/generate. top customers affected: fintech-one (540 failures), travelco (420), med-saas (200).

katie_cs: prepping status page and customer DM templates. need ETA for mitigation before I publish.

jess_oncall: immediate mitigations checklist executed: - fallback routing active - throttling rules set: max_batch_size=6, per-request token cap=1500 - seq_len hard reject for >4096 tokens - temporary rate limits on orgs with extremely high failure counts

 tom_runtime: we collected coredumps and ran gdb on one pod. backtrace (sanitized):
```
#0 0x00007f2c8b4f3a6b in memcpy () from /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6
#1 0x00007f2c9a1e2f10 in kv_append() at kv_cache.c:210
#2 0x0000561c2b9f4d22 in decode_chunk() at decode.c:511
#3 0x0000561c2b9f5e01 in inference_worker() at worker.c:134
```

 tom_runtime: indicates write past buffer in kv cache when handling very long sequences + concurrent batch merges. also seeing 'Out of memory' logged right before crash on some pods.

rui_infra: autoscaler adjusted to avoid scheduling large-batch pods on nodes with <20GB free GPU memory. patch applied.

jess_oncall: roll hotfix? options: fast bounds-check and abort on oversize vs full allocator rewrite. choose fast bounds-check for immediate canary. tom, can you build image and start canary?

tom_runtime: building quick-fix image: registry.redwood/inference/runner:hotfix-3345678901 (adds bounds check + safer memcpy). kicking off canary (5%).

deploy-bot: canary rollout started: hotfix image at 5% traffic. canary pods created.

r ui_infra: monitoring canary logs — no crashes in first 8 minutes. gateway 5xx trending down from 16% -> 6%.

status_bot: customer impact update: failed requests in last 10m reduced to ~340. fintech-one failures down to 80.

katie_cs: drafting status page: note that we're routing to fallback variant and rolling hotfix canary. will post once stable for 15m.

jess_oncall: increase canary to 30% at +12m. keeping strict telemetry on memory and segfault counts.

tom_runtime: canary healthy, increasing to 100% at +22m. continuing to monitor.

ops_lead: good. keep fallback routing in place for 1 hour after full rollout; we don't want regressions to hit customers. also file an automated post-incident task to reproduce with sequence length fuzzing.

rui_infra: cluster drains completed. nodes eu-gpu-12/14 are offline for investigation. cores uploaded to /snapshots/335567/3345678901.

status_bot: final snapshot (60m): total failed requests 2670; peak 5xx rate 21%; error rate at 60m 0.4%. affected customers top three: fintech-one (560), travelco (430), med-saas (210).

katie_cs: posted incident update on status.redwood.com: "We experienced elevated 5xx due to runtime crashes in our model-serving layer. Traffic was routed to a fallback model and a hotfix deployed. Error rates have returned to baseline. Follow-up postmortem forthcoming." link: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/3345678901

jess_oncall: incident resolved, downgrading severity. postmortem owners: tom_runtime (root cause & fix), rui_infra (node remediation + autoscaler rule), katie_cs (customer comms). action items: - write reproducer and fuzz test - schedule allocator redesign for next sprint - add guarding metrics for seq_len spikes - automate fallback routing on crash surge

ops_lead: recommend offering account credits to top impacted customers. katie, coordinate with finance.

katie_cs: noted, will follow up with account teams.

inc-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Please file a postmortem within 72 hours and link to incident id 3345678901. :white_check_mark:"
